pages.text: A wooden playhouse stood on one side of the yard. Three ladder rungs led to its window.
Lala wanted to wave from the window. Looking up at the ladder tilted their head back.
Mio climbed straight up and waved from the window.
Lala placed a foot on the first rung. The ladder creaked.
Lala climbed back down. "Three rungs are too high." Marks from the wood remained on their palms.
The children waved from the window in turn. Lala looked up from below.
Playhouse time ended. Lala had not climbed even one rung.
Teacher Bau held the bottom of the ladder firmly with both hands and nodded to Lala.
Lala climbed one rung, then another, then another.
Lala poked their face through the window and waved both hands wide.
